# Safety Replay Gate MCP

Paid remote MCP for AI agent safety replay checks, policy gates, eval receipts, control-fix suggestions, and release evidence exports.

Website: https://safetyreplay.clauxel.com/
MCP endpoint: https://safetyreplay.clauxel.com/mcp
Server card: https://safetyreplay.clauxel.com/server-card.json
Docs: https://github.com/clauxel/safety-replay-gate-mcp

Use case: Replay safety evals before agent releases move forward.
Authentication: Bearer token required for production use.
Tools: run_safety_replay, check_policy_gate, record_eval_receipt, suggest_control_fix, export_release_evidence
